sections.description:

ORDINANCE XLII OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE PROCUREMENT OF GOODS, WORKS, SERVICES AND CONSULTING SERVICES
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLII OF
2002
An Ordinance to
amend the North-West Frontier Province-Procurement of Goods Works Services and
Consulting Services Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 17th October, 2002]
No.LEGIS:1(13)/97/7511, dated
15-10-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title commencement.--(1)
This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier Province Procurement of
Goods, Works, Services and Consulting Services (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 2 of N.W.F.P. Ordinance No. XVIII of 2002

ORDINANCE XLII OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE PROCUREMENT OF GOODS, WORKS, SERVICES AND CONSULTING SERVICES
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLII OF
2002
An Ordinance to
amend the North-West Frontier Province-Procurement of Goods Works Services and
Consulting Services Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 17th October, 2002]
No.LEGIS:1(13)/97/7511, dated
15-10-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 2 of
N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. XVIII of 2002.--(1) In the North-West Frontier
Province Procurement of Goods, Works, Services and Consulting Services
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2002 (N.W.F.P. Ordinance No. XVIII of 2002), hereinafter
referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 2, for clause (c), the following
shall be substituted, namely:
"(c)
'Committee means the Departmental Consultant Selection Committee or, as the
case may be, the District Consultant Selection Committee, established under
section 3 of this Ordinance;"

Amendment of section 3 of N.W.F.P. Ordinance No. XVIII of 2002

ORDINANCE XLII OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE PROCUREMENT OF GOODS, WORKS, SERVICES AND CONSULTING SERVICES
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLII OF
2002
An Ordinance to
amend the North-West Frontier Province-Procurement of Goods Works Services and
Consulting Services Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 17th October, 2002]
No.LEGIS:1(13)/97/7511, dated
15-10-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
3. Amendment of section 3 of
N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. XVIII of 2002.--(1) In the said Ordinance, for
section 3, the following shall be substituted, namely:
"3.
Establishment of Committees.--(1) As soon as may be after the commencement of
this Ordinance, a Procuring Entity shall establish a Committee to be known as
the Departmental Consultant Selection Committee'. The Committee shall comprise
of such members, and shall exercise such powers and perform such functions, as
may be prescribed.
(2) The District Government concerned
shall establish for each District a District Consultant Selection Committee
which shall consist of such members, exercise such powers and perform such
functions as tray be prescribed."
